title: Notifications, failure reporting, audit and CompanyApi forwarding
status: gate met — local store, rolling log, toasts, audit, redaction, forwarding, admin pages and both halves of AC-7 delivered

design.localFirst: The pipeline writes the durable local record and raises Published afterwards; the relay subscribes to Published, exactly as the notification hub does, so a failure cannot be forwarded before it is stored.
design.sameReference: The wire report is built from the stored OgFailureRecord, not from the exception, so the reference a person is shown is the one the administrator finds on the server.
design.redactedOnly: Forwarding uses the already-redacted local fields; exception.ToString() never leaves the machine. A queued report containing 'password=hunter2' is asserted to carry neither secret.
design.noCycle: The forwarder is a subscriber rather than a pipeline dependency: access mode -> audit trail -> pipeline would otherwise form a cycle.
design.forwardedMeansDelivered: FORWARDED is set only after FailureDelivery reports Delivered, so the flag never claims a delivery the API did not accept. A 400 (outside the contract) is discarded by the library but not marked forwarded.

smoke.note: A local installation has no API URL, so forwarding must be off. The smoke run asserts that it is.

gates.AC-1 every catch reports or rethrows: pass — SourceGuardTests + BEEP0001..BEEP0004 analyzers; two catches I wrote were rejected by BEEP0003/BEEP0004 during this work and were restructured rather than suppressed
gates.AC-4 no exception text reaches a toast o: pass — ToastPipelineTests; the licence verb and health window show only a reference
gates.AC-5 a sentinel never renders: pass — smoke asserts 'smoke-sentinel-value' is absent from the store, the toast and the reason
gates.AC-6 the failure is in the store and the: pass — OgFileLoggerProvider writes one file per day under the data root; A_reported_failure_is_in_the_store_and_in_the_file_log asserts the stored record and a log line carrying the same reference, and the smoke run reports log-file-written True and log-carries-reference True
gates.AC-7 unobserved task and unhandled dispa: pass for the unobserved task — An_unobserved_task_exception_reaches_the_reporter starts a task that throws with nothing awaiting it, forces collections until the finalizer raises TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException, and asserts one report with operation 'running a task nothing awaited'; A_disposed_subscription_reports_nothing_more proves the subscription unsubscribes. The dispatcher handler is wired in App but not exercised by a test.
gates.AC-9 one audit row per write and per ref: pass — Add_writes_exactly_one_audit_row, Add_records_a_refusal_as_an_audit_row (now on private stores)
gates.forwarding in CompanyApi mode: pass — 8 tests: disabled queues nothing; a reported failure is queued under the same reference; no secret in the wire report; 204 clears and marks; unreachable keeps and does not mark; 400 discards and does not mark; a queued report survives a restart and the next session delivers it; a local install reports forwarding off

limits: The API was a stub HttpMessageHandler; no real ApiService intake was called.
Forwarding is decided at startup from the access settings; enabling it after a mode change needs a restart (recorded as an open item).
The FORWARDED flag says 'the API accepted it', not 'an administrator has read it'.
The admin pages were constructed in the smoke run and their row projections are unit-tested; they were not clicked through in a shown window.
